isolation: Two dedicated synthetic accounts; only private intentions. Reviewer uses the portal-designated email account; seller is operator-controlled and does not approve requests in these cases.
login_requirement: Portal-supported email-code sign-in using the pre-provisioned reviewer mailbox. Actual credentials and sign-in instructions belong only in secure portal fields.

buyer.text: Synthetic used M2 Mac mini, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD, working, proof of purchase, Singapore collection; maximum SGD 600.

seller.text: Synthetic used M2 Mac mini, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD, working, proof of purchase, normal wear, Singapore collection; SGD 550.

review_run: P1 creates a fresh buyer intent; P2 selects the pre-seeded seller; P3 requests exchange; P4 cancels it; P5 pauses only the P1 buyer. No seller login required.
